title: Opening Work Orders after a link shows your saved view
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • View: on Work Orders the List is shown (click List in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar; its tooltip reads "List").
  • Starting view: your saved List is on the All tab with Assigned to me off.
  • Needs no test data of its own.

Setup

  1. Work Orders > click the All tab; if Assigned to me is highlighted, click it to turn it off.
  2. Check the setup worked: reload Work Orders; the All tab is selected and Assigned to me is off.
custom_steps:
1. Open https://sv10043.qa.shopview.com/workorders?tab=estimate&assigned_to_me=1 in the address bar.
  2. Click Work Orders in the top menu.
  3. Read which tab is selected and whether Assigned to me is on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The All tab is selected and Assigned to me is off: your saved view, not the link's.

What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): After clicking Work Orders in the top menu, the Estimates tab is still selected and Assigned to me is still on (the address keeps ?assigned_to_me=1&tab=estimate); typing the plain Work Orders address shows your saved All view. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §2, hotspot 3; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (§1 Business Case). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

  • QA handoff hotspot 3: “The rebuilt Work Orders List. Check saved preferences against URL links, Back and Forward, location switch, stale rows after an edit, and sorting and paging.”
  • PRD §1 Business Case: “List remains the default and stays exactly as it is in production today; the only addition to the Work Orders page is the switcher that offers the two new displays.”
